description: Resolve the merchant-console type-safety cluster: ~55 @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any + no-unsafe-member-access/argument/call errors across apps/merchant-console/src/app/{audit,findings,mapping,transactions}/page.tsx, plus the react-hooks/exhaustive-deps 'rule not found' and no-misused-promises in src/hooks/use-api.ts. INDEPENDENT of FEAT-002; reviewable as its own frontend slice. Behavior-preserving: the rendered output must not change.
steps: In each page.tsx, the DataTableColumn cells are typed `(item: any)` while the column array is typed DataTableColumn<Record<string, unknown>>[]. Replace `any` with the proper row type. If a typed row interface already exists in scope (e.g. Transaction, a findings/audit/mapping row type), type the columns as DataTableColumn<ThatType>[] and cells as (item: ThatType). If no row type exists, define a minimal local interface capturing the accessed fields (e.g. transactionId, currency, amount, currentState, createdAt, method) and use it. Do NOT use `any` or blanket eslint-disable.
Ensure numeric fields like item.amount keep `.toLocaleString()` working (type as number); date fields as string|number|Date for `new Date(...)`.

For apps/merchant-console/src/hooks/use-api.ts: the `eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` references a rule from eslint-plugin-react-hooks which is NOT installed/configured, so ESLint errors 'Definition for rule not found'. Preferred fix: install eslint-plugin-react-hooks as a devDependency and register it in eslint.config.js for the Next app files (files: apps/*/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}) so the disable directive resolves. If installing a plugin is deemed out of scope, the fallback is to remove the stale disable comment - but that re-introduces no rule (acceptable since the rule was never active). Choose the plugin-install route for correctness; if network/registry issues arise, fall back and note it.

For the no-misused-promises at use-api.ts:135 (Promise-returning function where void expected): wrap the async call so the handler returns void (e.g. `() => { void fetchData(); }` if not already, or annotate). Verify it does not change behavior.
Verify on real disk with git diff. Run `pnpm build` (Next apps use ignoreBuildErrors but the tsc -b build must still pass for backend refs), `pnpm test` (2811), and `pnpm lint`.

findings: Lint BEFORE (this feature's slice): 58 errors / 0 warnings (57 merchant-console cluster + 1 backlog worker-test no-unsafe-return). AFTER: 1 error / 0 warnings (only the out-of-scope apps/worker/src/secret-leakage.integration.test.ts:326 @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-return, left for backlog per FEAT scope). Approach: each of the four pages already imported a proper row model, so typed the column arrays and cell params with the real types instead of `any`: transactions/page.tsx -> DataTableColumn<Transaction>/(item: Transaction); audit -> AuditEntry; findings -> Finding; mapping -> MappingEntry. DataTable is generic `T extends Record<string, unknown>` and TS interfaces lack an implicit index signature, so at each <DataTable> call site the typed columns and data are bridged with `as unknown as DataTableColumn<Record<string, unknown>>[]` / `as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[]` (verified via a scratch tsc test that the double-cast is required; direct assignment fails TS2322). This also removed the three `data={DEMO_X as any}` explicit-any casts on audit/findings/mapping. Rendered output unchanged (same fields, same formatting). use-api.ts: chose the plugin-install route (network OPEN_INTERNET). Installed eslint-plugin-react-hooks@5.2.0 as a root -w devDependency (package.json + pnpm-lock.yaml updated cleanly) and registered it in eslint.config.js in a new config block. NOTE: scoped that block to `apps/merchant-console/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}` rather than `apps/*/src/**` because enabling exhaustive-deps across all apps surfaced 7 pre-existing warnings in apps/operations-console/src/hooks/use-operator-api.ts (missing 'client' dep) which are outside this feature's scope; scoping keeps the change behavior-preserving and in-scope while still resolving the merchant-console 'rule not found' error. The stale `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` at line 128 now resolves to a real, active rule and is a used directive (verified with --report-unused-disable-directives: no report). no-misused-promises at return: wrapped fetchData in a void-returning useCallback (`const refetch = useCallback(() => { void fetchData(); }, [fetchData]);`) so UseApiState.refetch (() => void) receives a void-returning function; behavior identical (still calls fetchData). Files changed by THIS feature: apps/merchant-console/src/app/{audit,findings,mapping,transactions}/page.tsx, apps/merchant-console/src/hooks/use-api.ts, eslint.config.js (added reactHooks import + merchant-console react-hooks block), package.json (+eslint-plugin-react-hooks devDep), pnpm-lock.yaml. (Other modified files - transaction-routes.ts, secret-leakage test, packages/ui/*, and the FEAT-002 eslint.config.js edits - are from FEAT-002 and left in place.)
